title: MCP exposes fixed contract tools and refuses hidden operation dispatch
steps: Discover tools through tools/list using the MCP harness.
Call each contract tool and inspect its dispatched REST path.
Try overriding operation through path, body and top-level arguments; call the removed generic dispatcher.
Call apply without changes and with declared revision/retry headers.
expect: Every public contract operation except provisioning-only derive has a separate description, input schema and correct read/write annotations.
Every tool dispatches only its fixed contract operation.
Operation overrides and the removed dispatcher return JSON-RPC -32602 without a REST call.
Apply requires changes and preserves If-Match and Idempotency-Key.
fence: Fixed operation routes, explicit body properties and transport validation prevent undeclared operation dispatch.

tests: MCP exposes every callable contract operation separately and omits the dispatcher and provisioning
MCP contract tools dispatch only their fixed operation and reject operation injection before REST
MCP contract apply requires changes and preserves declared revision and retry headers
a domain directory imports only lib/ and db/, never another domain
